_signals.x_guidance:
Otto AI exposes 30+ endpoints for DeFi, market intelligence, and AI creative tools. All endpoints require x402 V2 payment (USDC on Base, Polygon, or Solana).

How to use:
1. GET/POST any endpoint — receive 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64-encoded)
2. Decode header to find accepts[] array with payment options (EIP-3009 USDC, Permit2 any ERC-20, Solana USDC)
3. Sign payment and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header
4. Receive 200 with data + signed receipt in PAYMENT-RESPONSE header
5. For read-only endpoints: use SIGN-IN-WITH-X header on subsequent requests (1hr free access)

Three agent categories:
- Market Intelligence (13 endpoints): News, token analysis, DeFi analytics, derivatives, TradFi macro
- AI Creative Tools (4 endpoints): Image gen, video gen, research, tx explainer
- Trading (13 endpoints): Portfolio, market data, swaps, bridges, perps
